mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent.user_quota (user_id, quota_qpm, quota_tpm, quota_concurrent, user_level, status, quota_percent,quota_windows) VALUES (#{userId}, #{quotaQpm}, #{quotaTpm}, #{quotaConcurrent}, #{userLevel}, #{status}, #{quotaPercent},#{quotaWindows})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, quota_qpm, quota_tpm, quota_concurrent, user_level, status, quota_percent,quota_windows FROM agent.user_quota ORDER BY user_level
mapper.update: UPDATE agent.user_quota SET quota_qpm = #{quotaQpm}, quota_tpm = #{quotaTpm}, quota_concurrent = #{quotaConcurrent}, user_level = #{userLevel}, status = #{status}, quota_percent = #{quotaPercent}, quota_windows = #{quotaWindows} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
